email.subject1: a signal play for Zone & Co
email.body1:
Kelsey, saw Zone & Co is scaling globally on Insight Partners backing and expanding its SuiteApp lineup.

A growth push like that usually means more in-market NetSuite accounts than the team can cover, and that is where good opportunities go quiet. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Zone & Co off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Kelsey, quick follow-up for Zone & Co.

As the product portfolio grows, the list of in-market accounts grows faster than headcount can, and most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit target. The gap tends to surface late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Zone & Co needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Kelsey, last bit of proof for Zone & Co.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to the CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Zone & Co's reply rate likely compares to other B2B SaaS vendors. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Kelsey, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A global growth push is its own kind of busy and I get it.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your revenue motion? I will tailor it to Zone & Co either way.
